liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Who Do You Love** (1 review): Reviewer calls the nearly complete take of this song in the practice session outstanding [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Who Do You Love - several instrumental takes**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Who Do You Love**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [8]
- **jam with short burst of vocal improvisation**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- Earliest performances in the archive: jam [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1966-03-09.136654.practise.sbd.mr.dat48k.sirmick.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 4 songs; 26 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audio quality miraculous and very listenable despite being a practice tape [7]
- **gd1966-03-09.sbd.sorochty.125516.flac16**: soundboard; 1 songs; 6 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording rough but acceptable, disliking the Guild Starfire guitar tone through an unmodified Fender Twin Reverb; Reviewer likes the guitar tone of the early band on this recording and had tried to reproduce it [3][4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer speculates the tape might come from the Red Dog Saloon in Virginia City, Nevada, from around that period [5]
- It is a practice session; the first unknown track showcases Pigpen's singing, and the closing jam is very spacey [7]
- The same track is also the subject of another listing, shnid 125516, and a YouTube video [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1966-03-09.136654.practise.sbd.mr.dat48k.sirmick.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: sbd > 7 inch Master Reel @ 7.5ips 1/2 track > dat(48k) [1]
- **gd1966-03-09.sbd.sorochty.125516.flac16**: transferred by Dave Sorochty; source: SBD > ?? > wav > cdr > wav via EAC > FLAC [2]
